# BonniePdfError

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Base type for errors raised by BonniePDF itself (content that cannot be encoded, a definition that cannot be read, SVG the profile does not support, tree operations that would produce invalid output), as opposed to errors from the platform or the caller's own code. Catch this to handle "BonniePDF rejected this input or operation" as a single category without enumerating every concrete error class.

The licence declaration errors are a separate category and do not derive from it.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `Error`.
